name: Enter Lock
description: 专为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的功能扩展插件，提供免配置一键安装与高效开发辅助。
descriptionEn: DeepSeek Harness plugin that locks the web chat composer Enter-send. Toggle with a lock button or Ctrl+Shift+K to prevent accidental sends while typing or editing long prompts; unlock to send. IME-safe and per-session.
author: MingLin
